cases.title: prints one line per hit with the snippet indented under it
cases.reason: Independent complete expected output verifies title/time/host, snippet indentation, resume command and result footer.

cases.title: omits the host and the resume line a paired host withheld
cases.reason: Withheld host/resume fields are absent while real result text remains, preserving paired-host redaction.

cases.title: says so when a hit matched with no text evidence
cases.reason: A hit without evidence retains its title and explicit no-text-evidence message.

cases.title: reports zero hits as an answer, not a failure
cases.reason: Empty results are a valid zero-count answer with elapsed-time footer.

cases.title: prints the cursor a caller passes back for the next page
cases.reason: Next-page cursor is rendered as a reusable CLI argument.

cases.title: admits more pages exist when the host issued no cursor
cases.reason: More-pages without a cursor produces an explicit host limitation.

cases.title: renders every truncation flag in words
cases.reason: All four truncation observations render distinct user-facing warnings.

cases.title: prints nothing about truncation when nothing was truncated
cases.reason: Nontruncated fixture omits misleading truncation warnings; adjacent complete output remains covered.

cases.title: prints the planner route only when the host sent debug
cases.reason: Debug remains opt-in and supplied planner route/terms/scope appear in actual output.

cases.title: reports a disabled index
cases.reason: Disabled service produces the concrete off-host answer.

cases.title: names an index that has not started
cases.reason: Not-ready service produces actionable startup-state text.

cases.title: tells an old host apart as a host with no service
cases.reason: Old/no-service host is distinguished from disabled/not-ready states without inventing availability.

cases.title: says the index moved and to drop the cursor
cases.reason: Stale cursor tells the caller to restart pagination after index movement.

cases.title: strips escape sequences a transcript could carry into the reader terminal
cases.reason: OSC52 clipboard and ANSI color sequences are stripped while surrounding text survives.

cases.title: strips an escape sequence a host put in %s
cases.reason: All five untrusted hit fields now require their sanitized visible text as well as no ESC. Original tests passed a mutation that dropped any field containing ESC; reviewed tests reject it.

cases.title: strips an escape sequence a host put in the next-page cursor
cases.reason: Unsafe next-page cursor preserves the reusable clean cursor and removes ESC.

cases.title: strips an escape sequence a host put in a repaired term
cases.reason: Unsafe repaired terms preserve both cleaned terms and remove ESC.

cases.title: strips an escape sequence a host put in a degraded %s
cases.reason: Both degraded-root and degraded-reason inputs must retain their cleaned line. Negative-only checks previously passed when contaminated fields were dropped.

cases.title: keeps a snippet on the one indented line it was given
cases.reason: Newlines/control characters flatten inside the existing title/snippet line without changing indentation.

cases.title: reports the indexer observations one per line
cases.reason: Complete independent expected status preserves counters, timestamps, generation and degraded root.

cases.title: keeps the count when a paired host withheld the root
cases.reason: Paired-host withheld root preserves count and recovery reason without exposing a path.
